quote: EGR1-dependent gene weighted network analysis in human HSC-associated IER2 target protein-specific regulators of PP2A activity, IL1B, TNFSF10 ligands, and CD69, SELP membrane molecules in old HSC module with immune and leukemogenic signature.
summary: SELP is named only as one member of an EGR1-linked gene module in aged human haematopoietic stem cells; nothing UC-related or specific to SELP.

quote: The module analysis filtered out 18 key genes, including Cxcl5, Arg1, Cxcl1, Spp1, Selp, Ptx3, Tnfaip6, Mmp8, Serpine1, Ptgs2, Il6, Il1r2, Il1b, Ccl3, Ccr1, Hmox1, Cxcl2, and Ccl2.
summary: Selp is one of 18 key module genes in an acute myocardial infarction bioinformatics analysis, with no specific result about it.

quote: As compared to healthy subjects, CD41/CD61 expression was significantly reduced (p<0.0001) and CD62p expression was significantly increased (p<0.0001) on platelets in dengue patients.
summary: P-selectin (CD62p) on platelets was increased in dengue patients versus healthy subjects; this is not an IBD study.
SELP here means silk-elastinlike protein polymers used for rectal drug delivery, not the P-selectin gene.
The CD4+CD62 lymphocyte subset refers to L-selectin on T cells after oral anti-TNF, not P-selectin.

quote: Although neutrophil mobilization to the blood was impaired in RIP2(-/-) mice following infection, the expression of CD62P, CD11a/18, CD11b, and CXCR2 on blood and lung neutrophils was not altered between infected wild-type (WT) and RIP2(-/-) mice.
summary: In a mouse E. coli pneumonia model, neutrophil CD62P expression did not differ between wild-type and RIP2-deficient mice; not a colitis study.

quote: Finally, platelet rich plasma from healthy controls was stimulated with rhIL-1 beta and rhIL-8 and assessed for activation dependent expression of platelet aGPIIb/IIIa and CD62 (p-selectin, GMP-140).
summary: CD62 (P-selectin) served as an activation readout on healthy platelets stimulated in vitro with IL-1 beta and IL-8; the paper's IBD finding concerns cytokine receptors.

quote: The decrease of such activated platelets immediately after the first LCAP may be an early marker for predicting the response in patients with severe UC.
summary: Activated platelets (CD62-P positive) falling after the first leukocytapheresis session may predict response in severe UC.

quote: KD platelet-monocyte aggregates (MPAs) are mediated by an initial interaction of P-selectin (cluster of differentiation 62P, CD62p) and its glycoprotein ligand 1 (PSGL-1).
summary: In Kawasaki disease, P-selectin/PSGL-1 mediates platelet-monocyte aggregates and inhibiting this loop prevents inflammation; not a UC study.

quote: The DE genes involved in the immune response included genes related to the inflammatory response (CD163), the innate immune response (TLR2, TLR4, MYD88, TIRAP), cell adhesion (CD34, SELE, SELL, SELP, ICAM-1, ICAM-2, VCAM-1), antigen processing and presentation (MHC protein complex) and angiogenesis (VEGF), together with genes encoding cytokines (interleukins).
summary: SELP is listed among many differentially expressed adhesion genes in S. suis-infected pigs, with no specific result.

quote: Increased concentrations of PS+, CD42a+, CD142+, CD45+, CD14+, and CD62P+ EVs were found in plasma from patients with RA compared to healthy controls, and the concentrations of PS+, CD42a+, CD14+, and CD62P+ EVs were positively correlated with the inflammatory parameters in RA patients.
summary: CD62P-positive extracellular vesicles were raised in rheumatoid arthritis plasma and correlated with inflammation; not an IBD study.

quote: The PC, 1 min PAR and levels of GMP-140, TXB(2), and vWF:Ag in active UC were significantly higher than those in remissive UC and normal controls (P0.05).
summary: Plasma GMP-140 (P-selectin) was higher in active UC than in remission and controls, indicating platelet activation.

quote: Cg01459453 (SELP gene) was the most differentiated in the GDM group versus non-GDM (73.6 vs. 60.9, p = 1.06E-11; FDR = 7.87E-06).
summary: A CpG site in SELP was the most differentially methylated in gestational diabetes blood and part of a candidate diagnostic panel; not UC.
CD62 here is the naive T cell marker (L-selectin) used to sort cells in a D-serine colitis model, not P-selectin.

quote: We also showed in a mouse model of stasis that the thrombus size (weight and length) and CD62P expression in the thrombus were higher and lower in the IL-9 group and IL-9 antibody group, respectively, than in the control group.
summary: CD62P expression in mouse venous thrombi followed IL-9 treatment or blockade; a deep vein thrombosis study, not colitis.
CD62 on T cells in this Crohn's trial refers to L-selectin, not P-selectin.

quote: In this study, GSE27447 microarray data were obtained from the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) database of the National Center for Biotechnology Information, and differentially expressed genes (DEGs) from GSE27447 were distinguished by Significant Analysis of Microarray.
summary: SRD5A3 appears only in a list of downregulated genes in a BRCA1 triple-negative breast cancer microarray analysis.

quote: Among the top associations, we recapitulated previously known, such as "SRD5A3-Abnormal full-field electroretinogram-recessive" and "GRHL2 -Nail dystrophy-recessive", and discovered one potentially novel, "RRAGA-Abnormality of the skin-dominant".
summary: A rare-disease tool recovered the known SRD5A3 recessive association with abnormal electroretinogram; nothing about UC.

quote: Allele-specific analyses revealed five distinct allelic expression patterns across individuals and identified tissue-specific deviations from balanced biallelic expression for several genes, most notably SRD5A3, PGM3, VPS13B, and GNE.
summary: A GTEx study of congenital glycosylation disorder genes found SRD5A3 shows tissue-specific allelic expression deviation in healthy tissues; not about UC.

quote: Machine learning yielded four metabolism-associated signature genes-CYP3A4, UGT1A6, HSD17B6 and SRD5A3-with diagnostic accuracy (AUC 0.72-0.84).
summary: SRD5A3 is one of four metabolic signature genes with modest diagnostic accuracy for UC and was downregulated by probiotic treatment in DSS colitis.

quote: Machine learning yielded four metabolism-associated signature genes—CYP3A4, UGT1A6, HSD17B6 and SRD5A3—with diagnostic accuracy (AUC 0.72–0.84).
summary: Preprint version: SRD5A3 is one of four metabolic signature genes with modest diagnostic accuracy for UC and was downregulated by probiotic treatment in DSS colitis.

quote: Conversely, genetically predicted higher expression of SRD5A3 (CD: OR, 1.175, 95% CI, 1.118-1.235; UC: OR, 1.134, 95% CI, 1.074-1.197), CDO1 (CD: OR, 1.202, 95% CI, 1.126-1.284; UC: OR, 1.264, 95% CI, 1.162-1.375), and FADS2 (CD: OR, 1.127, 95% CI, 1.072-1.184; UC: OR, 1.189, 95% CI, 1.114-1.268) were associated with increased CD and UC risk.
summary: Mendelian randomisation links genetically predicted higher SRD5A3 expression to increased UC and Crohn's disease risk.

quote: Foretinib is an oral multikinase inhibitor targeting MET, VEGF, RON, AXL, and TIE-2 receptors.
summary: TIE-2 is named only as one target of the multikinase inhibitor foretinib in a renal cancer trial; no result about it.
Tie2-GFP is used only as an endothelial lineage reporter to detect endothelial-to-mesenchymal transition in colitis fibrosis; no result about TEK itself.
Tie-2-Cre is used only as an endothelial/hematopoietic Cre driver to delete JAM-A; the study is about JAM-A, not TEK.
